meta.curriculum_authority: المركز الوطني لتطوير المناهج والتقويم (NCCD) - وزارة التربية والتعليم الأردنية
source_books: كتاب الطالب لمادة اللغة الإنجليزية للصف الخامس الفصل الأول (g5-eng-s1-student-book, Jordan Team Together series, Pearson/York Press)
دليل المعلم لمادة اللغة الإنجليزية للصف الخامس الفصل الأول (g5-eng-s1-teacher-guide) — read 2026-11-13 for the lesson structure only
meta.provenance_note: Read directly from the PDF via PyMuPDF on 2026-09-16 — extraction is clean (this book is in English, so none of the Arabic-extraction issues that hit other Grade 5 books apply). Unit titles, page numbers, vocabulary, grammar structures (with the book's own example sentences), and skill descriptors were taken from the book's own two-page 'Scope and sequence' table (pp. 4-5), which is unambiguous and easy to verify against the Contents page. Lesson structure, titles and aims: the teacher's guide, read lesson by lesson on 2026-11-13 (see known_gaps).
known_gaps: Since 2026-11-13 every unit carries the book's own lessons, read lesson by lesson from the teacher's guide (Objectives block and heading of each lesson): Welcome back = 3 lessons, each main unit = 12 (1 PB Vocabulary, 2 AB Vocabulary, 3 PB Story, 4 AB Story, 5 PB Grammar, 6 AB Grammar, 7 PB Vocabulary and Grammar with the song, 8 AB Vocabulary and Grammar, 9 Culture + project, 10 English in action + Pronunciation, 11 Reading, 12 Listening, Speaking and Writing). `order` is the book lesson number. The ids are NOT: u*_l1 and u*_l2 were the old two lessons and their ids are persisted, so u*_l1 = book Lesson 1 (Vocabulary) and u*_l2 = book Lesson 12 (Welcome back: Lesson 3), and the new u*_l3…u*_l12 are book Lessons 2–11 (Welcome back: u*_l3 = Lesson 2). Objective ids are positional and stored with exam questions, so u*_l1/u*_l2 keep their original objectives first and the lesson's own aims follow. u*_l1 keeps the whole unit's word list (it is the English corner lesson and the grammar unit is keyed on it); each later lesson names the words it introduces in its objectives ("New words: …") rather than in `vocabulary`, so the corner still has one lesson per unit.

Following the g7EngSem1.ts precedent for English-subject books, `main_idea_ar` and `objectives` hold literal English text (this book's own language), not Arabic; `title_ar` carries a plain Arabic gloss of the English title for search/display.

'Welcome back' (the review unit opening the book) is included as Unit 1 here because it carries its own new vocabulary and grammar point in the scope-and-sequence table, not just a recap of Grade 4 — same treatment as every other unit.

Excluded as supplementary, non-core material (no dedicated row in the scope-and-sequence table): the two 'Bo's Learning Club: Language booster' spreads, the 'Festivals' pages (Harvest Festival, World Water Day), 'Solve it', and the 'Grammar reference' appendix.

Vocabulary corrected 2026-11-13: 'money' + 'box' were the scope table's line-wrapped 'money box' (the unit page, the PB p. 47 labels and the TG's target language all print 'money box'); duplicated pronunciation words already listed as vocabulary (untidy; planet, spacesuit, rocket, satellite, telescope) were removed.

Story titles: only Unit 1's story prints a title in the extracted text («Watch out for the cat!»); the other stories are titled from the teacher's guide's own plot summary. Songs without a printed title are identified by their first or chorus line.
